text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's all. I'm sorry,
but I don't think the
way you've been having me
run is...

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm sorry as well.
It looks like I put
you through a lot. And you, young
trainer—I must thank you for looking out
for her when I could not.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I do wish to do that... But you see, I'm
quite set in my ways as a trainer, and I'm
afraid that I will cause her to feel
trapped
again.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, why don't you consider
transferring your contract over to this

trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh? A transfer?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I know that way you'll get much more
flexible guidance. I can see
that this
trainer respects you very much, and that's
a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um...
W-would that be all right with you? I
mean...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's what I want! Thank you so
much... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Good for you, Suzuka! I can't wait to see
the fine racer you are sure to
become.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Just know that, should you ever take on
any of my trainees, I'll be
cheering harder
for them. I do hope you'll be ready.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I know that we just made things
official, but what should we do
about the
debut race I was supposed to run in next
month?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka fidgets about nervously, but her
eyes are full of fiery
determination. It
wouldn't make sense to extinguish that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In that case... what should we do about my
running style?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've come to understand that my runaway
style comes with its risks.
And one day, I
may no longer be able to keep myself in
the lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't deny that she's correct in her
thinking. However...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... need to run in the lead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I need to reach that place,
even if it's
just once more! I don't care
about anything
else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's so obsessed with being in the
lead...
In this respect, she already
possesses a
strength that's second to none.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If there exists potential beyond the
limits
of Umamusume, then it
would be achieved
by Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting out of the gate in the lead and
not giving it up even once... I
let her know
that it will be difficult, but by no means
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So that means...
You believe in my running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll prove that your faith is
well-placed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a strategy set, we're ready to begin
training for her debut race
in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Leading at the start of a race and not
losing speed even in the latter
half... How
can I achieve that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've been told that we have limited energy
for speed, so we need to
run in a way that
conserves it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest ramp training as a way for
her to strengthen both the
muscles that exert
explosive force and those that govern
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ramp training? Understood. Although...
I'm not sure if the academy
course is
enough of a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could... climb a mountain or
something? What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her passion thoroughly rekindled,
Silence Suzuka continually
produces
amazing results with every passing day of
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Until, at last...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove! You decided to come
watch me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, I've been a little worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, though that look on your face tells
me that I didn't have much
cause for
concern.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
It's almost time for me to get on the
track. See you soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Have a good run.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Clear blue skies greet a new group of
emboldened Twinkle Series
hopefuls!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Each runner has entered her gate. Their
debut race starts now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's favorite to win, Silence Suzuka,
takes an early lead, and with
unbelievable
speed leaves everyone else behind.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That Suzuka's incredible! Even as a front
runner, that's some shocking
speed right
from the get go!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but don't forget,
this is the Twinkle
Series! Can she really win
with that kind of
meathead strategy?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(It's still... so noisy.
I need to go farther!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hngh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Even in the last leg, Silence Suzuka
increases her speed! She keeps
pulling
away from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No way... Can she really keep it up?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(I won't let anyone get in my way. I won't
give up the lead!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: This scenery... is mine alone!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka crosses the finish with
seven lengths to spare! You
don't often
see a front running performance like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable, Suzuka! You're an absolute
monster!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, not quite.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The views will surely only get better from
here, Trainer!
